title: Solve Multiple Percent Equations with List Regression
description: Translate connected percent statements, pair them in one list regression, use supplied measurements or a positive free reference, and verify the ratios before reporting the requested percent.

questions.stem_html: Amount A is 60% of amount B. Amount B is 50% of amount C. Amount A is what percent of amount C? Enter the number without the percent sign.
questions.explanation_html: Set a positive reference C = 100. Then B = \(50\) and A = \(30\). That makes A \(30\)% of C.
questions.variation: Pair two percent-of conditions and a requested percent

questions.stem_html: Amount A is 20% greater than amount B. Amount B is 75% of amount C. Amount A is what percent of amount C? Enter the number without the percent sign.
questions.explanation_html: Set a positive reference C = 100. Then B = \(75\) and A = \(90\). That makes A \(90\)% of C.
questions.variation: Pair a percent increase with a percent-of relation

questions.stem_html: A tank initially held 320 liters. Its contents increased by 25% on Monday. On Tuesday, they decreased by 20% of Monday’s ending amount. How many liters were in the tank at the end of Tuesday?
questions.explanation_html: Keep the measured base 320. Pair Monday = 320 × 125/100 = 400 and Tuesday = 400 × 80/100 = 320.
questions.variation: Keep the supplied amount fixed across an increase and a decrease

questions.stem_html: Amount B is 60% of amount C. Amount A is 25% of the sum of B and C. Amount A is what percent of C? Enter the number without the percent sign.
questions.explanation_html: With C = 100, B = \(60\). Apply 25% to the complete combined base, \(160\). The result is \(40\) per 100 of C.
questions.variation: Include a combined base in the paired equations

questions.stem_html: A batch’s mass increased by 50% and then decreased by 20% of the new mass. Its final mass was 360 grams. What was its original mass, in grams?
questions.explanation_html: The two factors are 150/100 and 80/100. Fit both conditions with the final mass fixed at 360. Dividing by the product gives 300 grams.
questions.variation: Fit connected changes to recover the supplied final amount
